# Eval y=f(x) Optimal Step

![Eval y=f(x) Optimal Step function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/formula-evaluation/10_Eval%20y%3Df%28x%29%20Optimal%20Step%20VI.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Samples y=f(x) with actual bounded adaptive refinement. points is the initial count, epsilon is a positive finite FROG geometric tolerance, default 0.05. Additional quarter/mid/three-quarter probes estimate error; this is not a certified global bound or the unpublished NI algorithm. Fixed exact f64/Array signatures, without scalar lifting, broadcasting or implicit numeric conversion. Explicit FROG profile frog.studio.formula.evaluation@1 is distinct from the historical ODE dialect. Prepared payloads are validated versioned AST, never source to re-parse at evaluation or native pointers. NI connector documentation does not establish prepared binary compatibility or measured algorithm parity. error:i32 is local GS status (0=success); ticks:u32 measures elapsed calculation milliseconds, not point count.
